status: exploratory comparisons on an outcome-inspected historical test set
selection: First 30 eligible validation days; minimize hard common daily cost with a zero-action incumbent and 0.10 EUR/day replacement margin; deterministic candidate order. Freeze before test evaluation.

heuristic.price_threshold_source: All training-partition prices, shared with the price-rule baseline
heuristic.terminal_treatment: Reserve enough remaining charging capacity to recover target SoC; exact common one-interval minimization at the final action. Terminal charge remains soft and identically billed.
heuristic.test_replication: Three winter fee anchors; central-fee rule additionally retuned on each season's validation days and evaluated on that season's first 30 test weekdays. No claim of zero-shot seasonal transfer.

solver_budget.fixed_states: First two validation winter weekdays; hours 8 and 16; SoC 0.2, 0.5, 0.8. Identical state, date, horizon and scenario stream across solve budgets.
solver_budget.closed_loop: First three eligible winter test weekdays; both fees, M=8 and M=16, stream 7301, budgets 5,60,300 s. Descriptive same-day comparisons with stored primary learned and M=2 results; not 30-day confirmatory inference.
solver_budget.recording: All first actions, primal/dual bounds, solver gaps, statuses and realized costs, without dropping failed or time-limited calls. Full-day runs are restartable by completed day, not by silently changing within-day timing.

surrogate.slope: fee / effective_width; envelope uses the greatest lower-envelope slope
surrogate.selection: Same 30 validation days at each winter fee anchor, then freeze selected slope and test on the same 30 winter days. Retain complete validation sweep.

resources: Each solver worker uses one CPU thread; execution records specify worker counts. SCIP solves run in Torch-free processes. Comparisons reuse stored learned policies. CUDA is used for neural computations when available.
interpretation: These comparisons are exploratory. Superiority is assessed from paired evaluation costs, not selected validation costs. Conditional solver-gap summaries depend on finite-gap availability and the states being solved.
